title: Foundations of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC): Regime Architecture and Methodological Principles of Entropy-Bounded Empiricism
description: This paper canonically defines Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) as a thermodynamic meta-framework where dynamics and structure emerge from regulated energy flow and entropy gradients. It formalizes the L0–L3 regime architecture, S0–S1 observational regimes, and Entropy-Bounded Empiricism (EBE) as methodological constraints on inference and model validity, providing a stable reference for subsequent EFC-based theoretical and empirical work.

Effective gravitational coupling.description: Scale/entropy-dependent modification of the effective gravitational coupling, parameterized by an entropy measure S(a) and coupling coefficient \beta.

Regime Response Surface.description: Two-dimensional response surface encoding how effective coupling varies across wavenumber k and entropy state S, organizing transitions between L-regimes.

key_results.main_finding: Establishes the canonical EFC framework, locking the L0–L3 regime architecture and Entropy-Bounded Empiricism as methodological gates for valid inference.

kill_criteria: KC1: Demonstration that a single, scale- and entropy-independent dynamical law (e.g., GR+ΛCDM with fixed parameters and \mu\equiv1) jointly and pre-registrationally fits CMB, BAO, SNe Ia, weak lensing, galaxy clustering/RSD, galaxy rotation curves, strong lensing, and cluster dynamics with residuals consistent with noise (no cross-scale systematics >2σ), eliminating the need for regime gating.

KC2: Cross-environment tests show no correlation between entropy production/entropy gradients and dynamical response: e.g., low-entropy dwarfs vs high-entropy clusters exhibit statistically identical residual dynamics after mass–light accounting, with differences consistent with zero at >5σ.

KC3: Three or more independent, pre-registered EFC regime-threshold predictions (e.g., L1→L2 onset tied to specified entropy/flux markers) are falsified at >3σ each with validated systematics, indicating the L-regime architecture does not map onto observed transitions.

KC4: High-precision constraints establish β=0±1e−3 (95% CL) in \mu(a)=1+\beta S(a) across all probed scales and environments, and R(k,S)=0 within 1e−3, demonstrating no entropy-dependent modification of effective coupling anywhere EFC claims applicability.

KC5: Robust, reproducible recovery of full, lossless state information from S1 (indirect, model-dependent) regimes in contradiction to entropy/information-capacity limits, thereby invalidating the core Entropy-Bounded Empiricism principle.
abstract_short: Foundational framework for Energy-Flow Cosmology establishing regime architecture (L0-L3), methodological principles of Entropy-Bounded Empiricism, and core equation μ(a) = 1 + βS(a).
core_principle: Theoretical models must specify their validity regimes and are not permitted to extrapolate beyond empirically constrained boundaries.
